evidence.quote: Duration of the course / programme: 7 semesters
Requirements Secondary school leaving certificate, secondary school level knowledge of mathematics

notes: The page gives no tuition fee, no application deadline/intake and no statement that the self-financed applicant applies via a university application form or via Stipendium Hungaricum, so tuition, intakes and applicationChannel are omitted. The page lists an English B2 minimum for both oral and written proficiency; the quote used is the oral one. The programme is listed as available in the Stipendium Hungaricum and Diaspora Scholarship programmes, but the page does not describe the application route.

evidence.quote: Secondary school leaving certificate, secondary school level knowledge of mathematics

note.fr: Un entretien d'admission oral en ligne de 15 minutes par Skype fait partie du processus de sélection; une lettre de motivation est également demandée.
note.en: A 15-minute oral admission interview on Skype is part of the selection process; a motivational letter is also requested.

evidence.quote: In the second part of the entrance examination a 15-minute-long skype-interview takes place with two opponens who decide together on the final score and the admission of the applicants.
